candidate_requirements.customer_goal: Build a tiny local notes CLI with README, tests, API evidence, and local model evidence

candidates.name: Local video material processing workbench
candidates.requirement_summary: A local-first workbench for ingesting video, extracting or simulating audio, chunking/transcribing, analyzing segments, selecting clips, and exporting reviewable artifacts.
candidates.target_user: Creators or operators who need repeatable local media processing.
candidates.core_problem: Raw media work becomes untraceable and hard to evaluate when it is reduced to a single preview.
candidates.product_shape: Desktop/web GUI plus CLI over a shared orchestration core.
non_goals: Guaranteed real speech recognition without configured model
candidates.why_it_matches_customer_goal: It turns the rough video-tool goal into a concrete local product with testable artifacts.
candidates.why_it_might_be_wrong: If the customer only wanted a tiny converter, this is larger than needed.
candidates.acceptance_summary: A run creates stage artifacts, GUI/CLI share the same core, and missing models are reported as degraded instead of success.

candidates.name: Independent team operating console
candidates.requirement_summary: A local team management product for milestones, tasks, assets, decisions, risks, playtest notes, and release-readiness evidence.
candidates.target_user: Small independent teams that need lightweight operational discipline.
candidates.core_problem: Team context gets scattered across task lists, asset folders, and decisions with no shared acceptance view.
candidates.product_shape: Project dashboard with CLI import/export and structured local storage.
candidates.why_it_matches_customer_goal: It interprets a team-tool goal as a decision and delivery coordination product.
candidates.why_it_might_be_wrong: If the customer wants only a generic kanban, this has more product structure than needed.
candidates.acceptance_summary: The product must prove that team artifacts, decisions, risks, and release status are connected and exportable.

candidates.name: Local research and source synthesis workspace
candidates.requirement_summary: A local research workspace for importing documents, extracting notes, linking source evidence, clustering topics, and producing traceable briefs.
candidates.target_user: Researchers or operators organizing local materials.
candidates.core_problem: Research notes lose provenance and cannot be reviewed when reduced to a static notes page.
candidates.product_shape: Local knowledge workbench with document intake, evidence graph, synthesis board, CLI batch run, and GUI review.
non_goals: Guaranteed OCR/model extraction without configured dependency
candidates.why_it_matches_customer_goal: It makes a vague research-workbench goal concrete and locally testable.
candidates.why_it_might_be_wrong: If the customer needs live web research, local-first mode is only the first version.
candidates.acceptance_summary: The output must preserve source-to-brief traceability and report degraded extraction honestly.

candidates.name: Cloud AI autopilot requirement
candidates.requirement_summary: A fully automated cloud AI product using live model APIs, remote queues, and managed storage.
candidates.target_user: Teams with provisioned cloud AI infrastructure.
candidates.core_problem: Automation is attractive but risky when credentials and services are unknown.
candidates.why_it_matches_customer_goal: It could fit an automation-heavy interpretation.
candidates.why_it_might_be_wrong: It depends on external accounts and is not safely deliverable as the first local version.
candidates.acceptance_summary: Would require live external credentials and therefore cannot be honestly accepted by default.

candidates.name: Single static page demo
candidates.requirement_summary: A one-page mockup with a few static cards.
candidates.core_problem: Shows a rough visual idea but does not solve the operating workflow.
candidates.why_it_might_be_wrong: It is too small and likely hides the real requirement.
candidates.acceptance_summary: A screenshot would exist, but it cannot validate the real customer workflow.
